name: Falcon
description: A bird of prey that has long, pointed wings and a notched beak.

abilities.name: Nimble Flyer
abilities.description: While flying, the Falcon gains a +3 bonus to its Difficulty.

abilities.name: Dive Bomb
abilities.description: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack against a target from above. The Falcon gains a +2 bonus to the attack and damage rolls.
